# BrandMark

A secondary geometric mark family — not the logo.

`SuDuAI.BrandMark` · Brand

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.BrandMark />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.BrandMark"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One of six supporting geometric marks supplied alongside the logo. Not a substitute for `Logo` — see BrandMark.prompt.md.

## Props (BrandMarkProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mark` | `'07' \| '08' \| '09' \| '10' \| '11' \| '12'` | Which mark, keyed by the supplied asset number. The client gave no names for these shapes. Default "07". An unknown key warns and renders nothing. |
| `size` | `number` | Rendered square size in px. Default 28. |
| `color` | `string` | Fill color. Default --primary-container (#00F5A9). |
| `title` | `string` | Accessible label. Default "SuDu AI". |
